capabilities: Color folders from a right-click menu entry
Cascade a folder's color to its subfolders and notes
Render colors as text color or rounded fading background bands
Customize palette, depth fade, bold names, indent lines, and active-note colors
disambiguation: Not a folder-management tool; it only adds colors and styling to the file explorer.
extras: Warns to disable other file-explorer coloring plugins to avoid conflicting styles; desktop only, needs Obsidian 1.13+; stores colors in its own data.json without modifying notes; no network or telemetry; releases carry build provenance attestations.
problem: In large vaults the file explorer becomes rows of identical grey folders, making it hard to tell at a glance where things belong.
summary: File explorer plugin that colors a folder and all its subfolders, shown as text color or fading background bands.
